subject: ヒュージポイズンクラブ
text: In the Flowing Water Corridor, activating the device at the far end opens the door beside the entrance and the Huge Poison Crab appears; defeating it lets you go to the 79th floor labyrinth Dragon Palace of Rushing Waves.

evidence.quote: 一番奥の装置を起動すると入口横の扉が開いてヒュージポイズンクラブが出現
evidence.translation: When you activate the device at the far end, the door beside the entrance opens and the Huge Poison Crab appears

evidence.quote: 倒すと79層迷宮区「奔波の竜宮」に行ける
evidence.translation: Defeating it lets you go to the 79th floor labyrinth Dragon Palace of Rushing Waves

subject: 天空へ誘う浮き雲の回廊
text: The route runs from the Spring of Twin Streams to the Floating Cloud Corridor Inviting to the Sky, and from the Floating Cloud Corridor to the 89th floor labyrinth Mausoleum of Muddy Torrents.

evidence.quote: 「双流統べし湧水場」→「天空へ誘う浮き雲の回廊」
evidence.translation: Spring of Twin Streams → Floating Cloud Corridor Inviting to the Sky

evidence.quote: 「天空へ誘う浮き雲の回廊」→89層迷宮区「濁流たる霊廟」
evidence.translation: Floating Cloud Corridor Inviting to the Sky → 89th floor labyrinth Mausoleum of Muddy Torrents

subject: 妖精イベント
text: After the 76th floor boss, an event at the teleport gate has Klein mention a rumor of a fairy event in the east forest.

evidence.quote: 転移門前でイベント、クラインから東の森の妖精イベントの噂を聞く
evidence.translation: Event in front of the teleport gate; hear from Klein the rumor of a fairy event in the east forest

subject: シノン
object: NMスカーレットディザスター
text: After clearing floor 86, take Sinon to the 86th floor Forward Base of the Living Dead 3F and fight NM Scarlet Disaster; afterwards Sinon learns a new sword skill.

evidence.quote: シノンを連れて86層「生ける屍達の前線基地3階」へ行き
evidence.translation: Take Sinon and go to the 86th floor Forward Base of the Living Dead 3F

evidence.quote: NMスカーレットディザスターと戦闘後シノンが新たなソードスキルを覚える
evidence.translation: After fighting NM Scarlet Disaster, Sinon learns a new sword skill

subject: 新婚旅行イベント
text: After clearing floor 87, talk to the depressed Asuna in Arc Sophia, then in daytime take Asuna to the 83rd floor town and choose the scenic spot to trigger the honeymoon event.

evidence.quote: 【87層まで攻略】...アークソフィアで落ち込んでいるアスナに話しかける
evidence.translation: Floors cleared through 87 ... Talk to the depressed Asuna in Arc Sophia

evidence.quote: 昼にアスナを連れて83層街で「景色のいい場所」を選択すると
evidence.translation: In daytime, take Asuna along and choose the scenic spot in the 83rd floor town

subject: 祝福の儀式
text: After clearing floor 86, talking to Asuna in Arc Sophia advances the quest Ritual of Blessing.

evidence.quote: 【86層まで攻略】...アークソフィアでアスナに話しかけるとクエスト「祝福の儀式」が進展
evidence.translation: Floors cleared through 86 ... Talking to Asuna in Arc Sophia advances the quest Ritual of Blessing

subject: 進化の鉱石
text: After clearing floor 81, talking to Silica in Arc Sophia gives information about the Evolution Ore.

evidence.quote: 【81層まで攻略】...アークソフィアでシリカに話しかけると「進化の鉱石」の情報を得る
evidence.translation: Floors cleared through 81 ... Talking to Silica in Arc Sophia gives information about the Evolution Ore

subject: 暴食の寝座
text: Going to the 84th floor labyrinth 2F forces a party with Strea up to the boss room, and you cannot go back.

evidence.quote: 84層迷宮区２階に行くとボス部屋まで強制でストレアとPT、後ろには戻れません
evidence.translation: When you go to the 84th floor labyrinth 2F you are forced into a party with Strea up to the boss room, and you cannot go back
